prezentacja_s11_q1: “How do I know this isn't a scam?”
prezentacja_s11_a1: We understand the skepticism. That's why: company registered in KRS, land in the land registry, 100% refund if we don't build. Check KRS number 0001188626 in the online KRS register - this is public information.
prezentacja_s11_a2: The Membership Card is yours — recorded in a public digital register. Company registered in KRS (number 0001188626), land in the land registry, public data.
prezentacja_s11_a3: You pay via regular bank transfer. You log in with your email. You receive a Membership Card — a legal document confirming your spot in the resort.
prezentacja_s11_a4: 14 nights × 6 people = 84 man-days per year. At a hotel price of 800 PLN/night, that's 67,200 PLN in value. You pay ~692 PLN per week. This isn't 'little' - it's math.
prezentacja_s11_a5: The Membership Card is transferable. You can sell your spot to another buyer at any time. 10% of the value goes to the community fund.
faq_timeline_q1: “When will the resort actually be built and how do I know it won't be in 10 years?”
faq_timeline_a1: We already have the land, signed architects, and are soon submitting the building permit application. Construction starts once two conditions are met: the building permit is issued + 100 signed reservation agreements. The deadline is October 30, 2026 - if both conditions are not met by then, you receive a full refund of 2,000 PLN with no deductions. You can track project progress in real-time in the app, with reservation counts and permit status updated every 30 days.
faq_timeline_q2: “What happens to my money if 150 people don't join?”
faq_timeline_a2: Stage 0 is 2,000 PLN and is 100% refundable. Refunds are issued automatically within 14 business days if we don't have 100 reservations or a building permit by September 30, 2026. No applications, no explanations, no deductions. Stages 1–4 start when construction begins, as payments are linked to specific work milestones.
faq_timeline_q3: “How much will I really pay over 10/20 years?”
faq_timeline_a3: Entry is a one-time payment. Stay: ~567 PLN per week for 4 people - that's what you pay for electricity, water, jacuzzi, and cleaning. Zero high annual fees when you don't visit. Over 20 years with 2 weeks annually: 25,990 PLN + 26,680 PLN operating costs = ~53,670 PLN total. The same standard in a hotel: 5,600–8,000 PLN per week × 40 weeks = 224,000–320,000 PLN. Difference: ~270,000 PLN stays in your pocket. In a hotel, you'll likely spend even more due to inflation.
faq_timeline_q4: “Who makes the decisions and does my vote change anything?”
faq_timeline_a4: The company manages operations - daily decisions, suppliers up to 50,000 PLN, personnel. The community votes on everything concerning your money and comfort: changes in operating costs, renovation fund, purchase of new land, changes to regulations. The land cannot be sold without the consent of 90% of members. Every fund transaction is publicly visible in the app panel. Votes are consultative - the management takes the result into account but is legally responsible for decisions.
faq_timeline_q5: “What happens to my spot if I don't go in a given year?”
faq_timeline_a5: You have three options. First: book a date and go. Second: share your date with a family member. Third: do nothing - the 14-night limit does not carry over to the next year, but you lose nothing financially. You only pay for the stay when you actually use it.
